DA_PR_open_page_arcane = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_projects_research_Interface_on_Electrical_1
	clr_country_flag = DA_projects_research_Interface_on_Steam_1
	clr_country_flag = DA_projects_research_Interface_on_Unique_1
	clr_country_flag = DA_projects_research_Interface_on_arcane_1
	clr_country_flag = DA_projects_research_Interface_on_arcane_2
	set_country_flag = DA_projects_research_Interface_on_arcane_1
}

	clr_country_flag = DA_projects_research_Interface_on_Steam_1

	clr_country_flag = DA_projects_research_Interface_on_Electrical_1
	clr_country_flag = DA_projects_research_Interface_on_Steam_1
	clr_country_flag = DA_projects_research_Interface_on_Unique_1
	clr_country_flag = DA_projects_research_Interface_on_arcane_1
	clr_country_flag = DA_projects_research_Interface_on_arcane_2
	set_country_flag = DA_projects_research_Interface_on_Unique_1
}

# Research queue (DA_PR_queue.1): start the queued node as its Start button would; else tell the player (DA_PR_queue.2).
DA_PR_start_queued = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 1 } }	# Arcane Energy
		if = {
			limit = { always = yes }
			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }	# finished meanwhile
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				hidden_trigger = {
					always = no
				}
			}

			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 2 } }	# Steam Power
		if = {
			limit = { DA_completed.Steam_Power_Project = yes }
			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }	# finished meanwhile
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				DA_available_research = yes
				DA_completed.Magic_Theory_2 = yes
				DA_completed.Mechanics_2 = yes
				DA_completed.Alchemy_2 = yes
				DA_yet_to_complete.Steam_Power_Project = yes
			}
			DA_start_research = {
				flag = steam
				time = 120
				steam = yes
				unstoppable = yes
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				country_event = {
					id = DA_project_event.300
					days = 30
				}
			}
			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 3 } }	# Electric Power
		if = {
			limit = { DA_completed.Electric_Power_Project = yes }
			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }	# finished meanwhile
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				DA_available_research = yes
				DA_completed.Magic_Theory_3 = yes
				DA_completed.Mechanics_3 = yes
				DA_completed.Alchemy_3 = yes
				DA_completed.Steam_Power_Project = yes
				DA_yet_to_complete.Electric_Power_Project = yes
			}
			DA_start_research = {
				flag = electric
				time = 180
				electric = yes
				unstoppable = yes
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				country_event = {
					id = DA_project_event.310
					days = 30
				}
			}
			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 4 } }	# Transcendent Technology
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { DA_has_transcendent_path_to_unlock = yes } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }	# finished meanwhile
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				DA_available_research = yes
				DA_completed.Electric_Power_Project = yes
				DA_has_transcendent_path_to_unlock = yes
			}
			# Mega Engineering: see "Claude files/tools/build_mega_engineering.py"
			DA_start_research = {
				flag = trascendence
				time = 240
				electric = yes
				unstoppable = yes
			}
			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 5 } }	# Fire Magic
		if = {
			limit = { DA_completed.Elemental_Magic_Fire = yes }
			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }	# finished meanwhile
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				DA_available_research = yes
				DA_completed.Magic_Theory_1 = yes
				DA_yet_to_complete.Elemental_Magic_Fire = yes
			}
			DA_start_research = {
				flag = fire
				time = 36
				arcane = yes
				unstoppable = yes
			}
			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 6 } }	# Water Magic
		if = {
			limit = { DA_completed.Elemental_Magic_Water = yes }
			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }	# finished meanwhile
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				DA_available_research = yes
				DA_completed.Magic_Theory_1 = yes
				DA_yet_to_complete.Elemental_Magic_Water = yes
			}
			DA_start_research = {
				flag = water
				time = 36
				arcane = yes
				unstoppable = yes
			}
			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 7 } }	# Earth Magic
		if = {
			limit = { DA_completed.Elemental_Magic_Earth = yes }
			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }	# finished meanwhile
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				DA_available_research = yes
				DA_completed.Magic_Theory_1 = yes

				flag = earth
				time = 36
				arcane = yes
				unstoppable = yes
			}
			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 8 } }	# Air Magic
		if = {
			limit = { DA_completed.Elemental_Magic_Air = yes }
			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }	# finished meanwhile

			limit = {
				DA_available_research = yes
				DA_completed.Magic_Theory_1 = yes

			}

				time = 36
				arcane = yes
				unstoppable = yes
			}
			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 9 } }	# Elemental Research
		if = {
			limit = {
				DA_available_research = yes
				DA_completed.Magic_Theory_1 = yes
				OR = {
					DA_completed.Elemental_Magic_Water = yes
					DA_completed.Elemental_Magic_Air = yes
					DA_completed.Elemental_Magic_Fire = yes
					DA_completed.Elemental_Magic_Earth = yes
				}
			}
			country_event = {
				id = DA_General_Research_events.10
			}
			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 10 } }	# Clockwork I
		if = {

			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }	# finished meanwhile
		}
		else_if = {

				}
			}
			DA_start_research = {

				unstoppable = yes
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				country_event = {
					id = DA_project_event.200
					days = 30
				}
			}

		}
	}
	else_if = {

		if = {
			limit = {

				DA_completed.ClockWork = yes
			}
			DA_start_research = {

			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }	# finished meanwhile
		}
		else_if = {

				time = 48
				arcane = yes
			}
			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {

				time = 72
				steam = yes
			}
			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = DA_PR_queue.2 }
	}
}
